params.1273: Harvest a crop of marigolds from a flower patch.
params.1274: You will need a marigold seed. You can pickpocket these from Master Farmers (with sufficient Thieving) or buy them.
params.1275: Marigolds are grown in a flower patch; these tend to be found in the centre of allotments such as the one south of Falador.
params.1276: The presence of marigolds protects onions, tomatoes and potatoes in adjacent vegetable patches from becoming diseased.
